transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As we approach Friday's planned opening of Night Frames, I need to convene our standard pre-opening roundtable. I have the draft operating package in front of me — it places the installation on the North Facade, uses front projection, admits visitors through the west gate, and includes the presenting sponsor's logo in the projected artwork. Before I can approve the final package and we announce and open to visitors, I need each of you to report your final checks. Technical director, can you walk me through your assessment of the North Facade and front projection setup? Rights and partnerships manager, I need your sign-off on the sponsor logo placement. And accessibility coordinator, please give me your read on the west gate visitor access. Let's work through these one at a time.

transcript.text: Mara, I need to flag a critical issue before we proceed. My post-draft rigging test found that the North Facade cannot safely support the planned front-projection position. I tested the South Arcade as an alternative and confirmed it works with a rear-projection setup using an 18-meter throw. I filed the test report with technical production this morning, but it hasn't yet been added to your approval packet. The draft package as written isn't safe to execute — we need to revise it to reflect the South Arcade and rear-projection setup before approval.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Mara, I can't sign off on the sponsor logo placement as drafted. My rights review of the artist's executed license — completed after the sponsor artwork was drafted — found that the licensed work may not contain sponsor logos or paid promotional marks. We may acknowledge the sponsor in printed programs, but the projected artwork itself must contain no sponsor branding. I haven't yet updated the partnership deck to reflect this. So the current draft package is not compliant on this point and needs to be revised to remove the sponsor logo from the projected artwork before I can sign off.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Mara, I can't sign off on the west gate visitor access as drafted. My accessibility walkthrough, completed today, confirmed that the west gate has a stair-only approach after dusk — visitors using wheelchairs or mobility devices cannot enter that way and must use the east gate instead. The accessible route through the east gate requires the public entry time to be set at exactly 7:30 PM so that route lighting and attendants are in place. The route map is still with the visitor-services team, so I don't have it to share yet, but the draft package needs to be revised to reflect east gate entry and a 7:30 PM public entry time before I can sign off.
